parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The display language of the zone name **LocalName** in the response. Valid values:

- **zh-cn**: Chinese.

- **en-us**: English.

- **ja**: Japanese.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the zones reside. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: ZoneType
parameters.description: The type of zones to query. Default value: **AvailabilityZone**, which indicates a standard cloud zone.
